title: From The Roof To The Water (Pete McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums honest character arc unhurried
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He built his first roof at twenty-two
Didn't think much about the ocean view
Just timber, tiles and sky above
That's a young man's work, that's a young man's love

[Verse 2]
Twenty years of rooftops, Perth in summer heat
Said one day he'd find himself the sea
Couldn't tell you why the water called
Maybe because from every roof, you see it all

[Chorus]
From the roof to the water, that's the road he took
Traded in the hammer for the anchor and the hook
Same man, same hands, same eyes looking far
From the roof to the water — that's who you are

[Bridge]
Chas said to Wilma one night — watch Pete
He's always known exactly where he needs to be
You don't stop a river, you don't stop a tide
You don't stop Pete McIvor when he's decided on a ride

[Verse 3]
Pelican Charters, sunrise on the bay
Oldest son became the captain of the day
Corey found the ocean too, just in his own way
And Joel got the girl from the farm down Zimbabwe way

[Chorus]
From the roof to the water, that's the road he took
Traded in the hammer for the anchor and the hook
Same man, same hands, same eyes looking far
From the roof to the water — that's who you are

[Outro]
From the roof to the water
From the roof to the water
That's my boy
That's my boy
